verdict.rationale: Snowflake documents its own background automation: Snowpipe continuously loads files as they arrive, without manual COPY runs on a schedule. dbt Projects on Snowflake also offers managed orchestration of transformations, and resource monitors can automatically suspend warehouses at credit limits. However, the evidence covers only these narrow, data-pipeline-specific automations, not general user-defined autonomous automations or AI-agent-driven background jobs. Missing for 10: a documented general-purpose scheduler or task facility for arbitrary user automations, agentic or AI-driven automations running unattended, detail on how dbt orchestration is scheduled, and independent hands-on corroboration of these automations.
